cloze_104.source: The dark ink in a marker may contain several coloring substances. As water moves through paper, it carries some dissolved colors farther than others, leaving separate bands that reveal the mixture. The different distances reflect how the substances interact with both the water and the paper. A single dark spot can thus become a pattern with several visible shades. This method is called paper chromatography. Not every marker produces the same result, since inks contain different ingredients and some do not dissolve readily in water.
cloze_104.translation: 记号笔中的深色墨水可能含有多种着色物质。当水穿过纸张时，它会将一些溶解的颜色带到比其他颜色更远的地方，留下单独的条带来显示混合物。不同的距离反映了物质如何与水和纸张相互作用。因此，单个黑点可以变成具有多种可见色调的图案。这种方法称为纸色谱法。并非每种记号笔都会产生相同的结果，因为墨水含有不同的成分，并且有些墨水不易溶于水。

cloze_105.source: A contour map represents the height of land using a series of curved lines. Each line links points at the same height, while the spacing between neighboring lines helps readers judge how steep the land is. On a map with a fixed height interval, closely spaced contours show a rapid rise over a short horizontal distance. Wider spacing indicates a gentler slope. The printed lines are not paths on the ground. They are a way of translating a three-dimensional surface into relationships that can be read on flat paper.
cloze_105.translation: 等高线图使用一系列曲线表示土地的高度。每条线都连接相同高度的点，而相邻线之间的间距可以帮助读者判断土地的陡峭程度。在具有固定高度间隔的地图上，间隔紧密的等高线在较短的水平距离内显示出快速上升。间距越宽表示坡度越平缓。打印的线条不是地面上的路径。它们是将三维表面转化为可以在平面纸上阅读的关系的一种方式。

cloze_106.source: The familiar lunar phases come from a changing view of the Moon's sunlit side. The Sun lights half of the Moon, but observers on Earth see different portions of that illuminated half as it travels around our planet. Sometimes much of the bright side faces us; at other times only a narrow part is visible. The Moon itself remains approximately spherical throughout this cycle. Ordinary phases are not caused by Earth's shadow covering the surface. Instead, they depend on the changing arrangement of the Sun, Earth, and Moon.
cloze_106.translation: 熟悉的月相来自我们观察月球受光面的角度变化。太阳照亮了月球的一半，但当月球绕地球运行时，地球上的观察者会看到被照亮的一半的不同部分。有时，受光面的大部分朝向我们；有时只能看到狭窄的部分。在整个周期中，月球本身保持近似球形。通常的月相并不是由覆盖月面的地球阴影引起的。相反，它们取决于太阳、地球和月亮的变化排列。

cloze_107.source: A shiny surface does not tell a student whether a metal will stick to a magnet. Some metals respond strongly to magnets, whereas others show no obvious attraction in an ordinary classroom test, despite looking similar. Iron and aluminum can therefore fall into different groups even when both pieces look silver in color. Testing gives a classification based on behavior rather than appearance. Students can record their predictions before bringing the magnet close. Comparing the two lists shows which visual guesses were useful and which depended on an unreliable assumption.
cloze_107.translation: 闪亮的表面并不能告诉学生金属是否会粘在磁铁上。有些金属对磁铁有强烈的反应，而另一些金属尽管看起来很相似，但在普通的课堂测试中没有表现出明显的吸引力。因此，即使铁和铝看起来都是银色，也可以分为不同的组。测试根据行为而不是外观进行分类。学生可以在靠近磁铁之前记录他们的预测。比较这两个列表可以看出哪些视觉猜测是有用的，哪些取决于不可靠的假设。

cloze_108.source: Water can help measure the volume of a solid with an irregular shape. An object placed entirely beneath the surface pushes aside an amount of water equal to its own volume, provided it neither dissolves nor absorbs water. The observer records the water reading before and after lowering the solid into a measuring cylinder without spilling any liquid. The difference between the readings gives the space occupied by the object. This method avoids the difficulty of measuring every curve of a stone with a ruler. It measures volume, not weight.
cloze_108.translation: 水可以帮助测量不规则形状固体的体积。完全置于表面之下的物体会推开与其自身体积相等的水量，前提是该物体既不溶解也不吸收水。观察者记录将固体放入量筒之前和之后的水读数，而不溢出任何液体。读数之间的差异给出了物体所占据的空间。这种方法避免了用尺子测量石头每条曲线的困难。它测量的是体积，而不是重量。

cloze_109.source: A shared draft is easier to discuss when its revisions remain visible. The record shows which sentences were added or removed and who made each change, allowing editors to recover an earlier version when necessary. This history can explain why a paragraph no longer matches a comment written the day before. It also lets collaborators distinguish a new proposal from an agreed revision. Keeping the previous wording does not mean that every change should be reversed. It gives the group a clearer basis for deciding what to retain.
cloze_109.translation: 当共享草稿的修订仍然可见时，它更容易讨论。该记录显示了添加或删除了哪些句子以及进行了每项更改的人，从而允许编辑在必要时恢复早期版本。这段历史可以解释为什么某个段落不再与前一天写的评论相匹配。它还可以让合作者区分新提案和商定的修订。保留之前的措辞并不意味着每项更改都应撤销。它为团队决定保留哪些内容提供了更清晰的基础。

cloze_110.source: A transcript needs conventions for sounds that are not spoken words. One team places short descriptions inside brackets whenever speakers laugh or pause, while ordinary words remain outside these added markers. The group's guide uses separate labels for laughter and for a noticeable break in speech. Readers can then tell which words were actually said and which information was supplied by the transcriber. Such a system cannot preserve every feature of a voice. It makes selected features visible in writing while keeping them distinct from the speaker's wording.
cloze_110.translation: 文字记录需要对非口语单词的声音进行约定。每当演讲者大笑或停顿时，一个团队就会在括号内放置简短的描述，而普通单词则保留在这些添加的标记之外。该团体的指南对笑声和明显的言语中断使用了单独的标签。然后，读者可以分辨出哪些单词实际上是说的，哪些信息是由转写人员提供的。这样的系统无法保留声音的所有特征。它使选定的特征在书面中可见，同时保持它们与说话者的措辞不同。

cloze_111.source: A story can be told through the limited viewpoint of one character. Readers learn only what this character notices, although other people in the story may understand events very differently or know facts that have not yet been revealed. A closed door might seem threatening to the central figure but ordinary to someone in the next room. This difference can create suspense without requiring anyone to lie. As more information appears, readers reconsider earlier scenes and separate the character's interpretation from what the story has actually established.
cloze_111.translation: 一个故事可以通过一个角色的有限视角来讲述。读者只了解这个角色注意到的内容，尽管故事中的其他人可能对事件有很大不同的理解或知道尚未揭示的事实。一扇关着的门对中心人物来说可能是一种威胁，但对隔壁房间的人来说却很平常。这种差异可以创造悬念，不需要任何人撒谎。随着更多信息的出现，读者会重新考虑之前的场景，并将角色的解释与故事实际建立的内容分开。

cloze_112.source: The same sentence can have different effects when performed in different ways. Small gestures can alter how an audience interprets words without changing the dialogue itself, because meaning also depends on delivery. A cheerful expression of thanks may sound doubtful when followed by a long silence and a raised eyebrow. In rehearsal, actors can try several combinations and discuss what each one suggests. The written line remains constant, making the effect of performance easier to compare. Voice and movement provide another layer through which the audience understands the scene.
cloze_112.translation: 同一句话，用不同的方式来表达，会产生不同的效果。小手势可以改变观众对词语的理解，而不会改变对话本身，因为意义也取决于表达。兴高采烈地表示感谢，但随后是长时间的沉默和扬起眉毛，这可能听起来令人怀疑。在排练中，演员可以尝试几种组合并讨论每种组合传达的意思。书面台词保持不变，因此更容易比较表演方式产生的效果。声音和动作提供了观众理解场景的另一个层面。

cloze_113.source: A scientific explanation often states conditions as well as a general relationship. General rules remain useful only provided the circumstances specified in their description still apply; otherwise, an apparently similar case may require a different conclusion. For example, a classroom rule might predict equal travel times for objects covering equal distances at the same constant speed. Changing the speed removes one of those conditions. A different travel time would then be consistent with the explanation. It would not show that the original relationship had suddenly stopped working.
cloze_113.translation: 科学解释通常会陈述条件以及一般关系。一般规则只有在其描述中指定的情况仍然适用的情况下才仍然有用；否则，看似相似的情况可能需要不同的结论。例如，课堂上讲解的一条规律可能预测：物体以相同的恒定速度走过相同距离，所需时间也相同。改变速度可以消除这些条件之一。不同的旅行时间将与解释一致。这并不表明原来的关系突然失效了。

cloze_114.source: A teacher may use one concrete case to introduce a general concept. An example makes an abstract idea easier to follow, but its details should not silently replace the broader principle being explained. Sorting a set of colored blocks may illustrate classification, yet color is only one possible basis for forming groups. Shape or material could support a different arrangement. Learners benefit from asking which features belong to the principle and which belong only to the demonstration. That distinction helps them use the idea in situations unlike the original example.
cloze_114.translation: 教师可以使用一个具体案例来介绍一个一般概念。一个例子可以让抽象的想法更容易理解，但它的细节不应该默默地取代正在解释的更广泛的原则。对一组彩色块进行排序可以说明分类，但颜色只是形成组的一个可能基础。形状或材料可以支持不同的布置。学习者可以通过询问哪些特征属于一般原理、哪些仅属于演示而受益。这种区别有助于他们在与原始示例不同的情况下使用这个想法。

cloze_115.source: The yellow of an autumn leaf need not be a newly created color. As green pigment breaks down, yellow colors that were already present become easier to see, although some red pigments are newly produced during autumn. The green pigment, called chlorophyll, usually dominates the leaf's appearance in summer. Its decline reveals colors that were less noticeable before. This does not give every tree the same display. The combination of pigments and conditions such as temperature helps explain why neighboring trees may show different shades.
cloze_115.translation: 秋天叶子的黄色不一定是新创造的颜色。随着绿色色素的分解，已经存在的黄色变得更容易看到，尽管一些红色色素在秋季新产生。绿色色素，称为叶绿素，通常在夏季主导叶子的外观。它的衰落揭示了以前不太引人注目的颜色。但这并不意味着每棵树都会呈现相同的色彩。色素和温度等条件的结合有助于解释为什么邻近的树木可能会呈现出不同的色调。

cloze_116.source: For a fungus that forms mushrooms, the visible cap is only part of the organism. A mushroom releases spores, but much of the organism can remain hidden as fine threads that spread through soil or decaying wood. These thin strands form a network that absorbs nutrients from its surroundings. Spores are tiny reproductive units that can develop when they reach suitable conditions. Seeing a cap disappear therefore does not necessarily mean the entire fungus has gone. The less visible network may still occupy the material below the surface.
cloze_116.translation: 对于形成蘑菇的真菌来说，可见的菌盖只是生物体的一部分。蘑菇会释放孢子，但这个生物体的大部分可能仍以细丝状隐藏在土壤或腐木中，并在其中延伸。这些细丝形成一个网络，从周围吸收营养。孢子是微小的生殖单位，当它们达到合适的条件时可以发育。因此，看到菌盖消失并不一定意味着整个真菌都消失了。不太明显的网络可能仍然占据表面以下的材料。

cloze_117.source: A migration route includes important places between its starting point and its destination. Many birds depend on places where they can feed and rest before continuing their journey across long stretches of open water. Such stops allow travelers to rebuild the energy used in flight. A small patch of suitable habitat can therefore matter even if no birds remain there all year. Different species need different food and shelter. Protecting only the places where a journey begins and ends can leave these intermediate needs unmet.
cloze_117.translation: 迁徙路线包括其起点和目的地之间的重要地点。许多鸟类在继续穿越漫长的开阔水域之前，都依赖于可以进食和休息的地方。这样的停留可以让旅客重新获得飞行中使用的能量。因此，即使全年没有鸟类留在那里，一小片合适的栖息地也很重要。不同的物种需要不同的食物和住所。仅保护旅程开始和结束的地方可能会导致这些中间需求得不到满足。

cloze_118.source: Tiny openings in a leaf allow gases to move between the plant and the air. When these openings are wide, carbon dioxide can enter, but water also escapes through them as vapor, creating a tradeoff between gas exchange and water loss. The openings are called stomata. Cells around them can change their width in response to conditions. Closing them can conserve water, yet it also restricts the entry of the gas needed for photosynthesis. The plant's problem is therefore not simply to keep every opening as wide as possible.
cloze_118.translation: 叶子上的微小开口允许气体在植物和空气之间移动。当这些开口较宽时，二氧化碳可以进入，但水也会以蒸气的形式通过它们逸出，从而在气体交换和水损失之间形成权衡。这些开口称为气孔。它们周围的细胞可以根据条件改变宽度。关闭它们可以节省水，但也限制了光合作用所需气体的进入。因此，植物的问题不仅仅是保持每个开口尽可能宽。

cloze_119.source: A beaver dam can change a stream well beyond the sticks that form it. Water moves more slowly behind the barrier, so particles may settle out instead of being carried farther downstream by the current. A pond can develop where water collects, creating conditions different from those in a fast channel. Some organisms benefit from these changes, while others may lose suitable habitat. Stored sediment can also move again if the dam breaks. Understanding the structure therefore involves following water and material over time, not just looking at its shape.
cloze_119.translation: 海狸用树枝筑成的坝，可以影响溪流中远超坝体范围的区域。水在屏障后面移动得更慢，因此颗粒可能会沉淀下来，而不是被水流带到下游更远的地方。池塘可以在水聚集的地方形成，创造与湍急的河道不同的条件。一些生物体从这些变化中受益，而另一些生物体可能会失去合适的栖息地。如果大坝溃决，储存的沉积物也可能再次移动。因此，了解结构需要随着时间的推移跟踪水和材料，而不仅仅是观察其形状。

cloze_120.source: Camouflage works through the relationship between an object and its surroundings. A pale shape may disappear against light sand but become obvious when placed on dark soil, even though its own color has not changed. A classroom demonstration can make this relationship visible with paper cutouts on two different backgrounds. Observers search for each shape and compare where it is easiest to notice. The activity represents only one part of animal camouflage. Movement, lighting, shape, and the observer's vision can also affect whether a real animal is detected.
cloze_120.translation: 伪装是通过物体与其周围环境之间的关系来发挥作用的。苍白的形状可能会在浅色沙子中消失，但当放在深色土壤上时会变得明显，即使其本身的颜色没有改变。课堂演示可以通过两种不同背景上的剪纸使这种关系变得可见。观察者搜索每个形状并比较最容易注意到的位置。该活动仅代表动物伪装的一部分。运动、照明、形状和观察者的视觉也会影响是否检测到真实的动物。

cloze_121.source: A metaphor can use a familiar object to explain an abstract relationship. A writer describes an argument as a bridge because it connects ideas that initially seem separate, without claiming that any physical structure has been built. The comparison draws attention to connection rather than to wood, steel, or distance. Readers understand the argument through this selected feature of the bridge. They would misunderstand the sentence if they tried to apply every property of an actual bridge. A useful comparison highlights a relationship while leaving other features aside.
cloze_121.translation: 隐喻可以用熟悉的物体来解释抽象的关系。作家将论证描述为一座桥梁，因为它连接了最初看似独立的想法，但没有声称已经建立了任何物理结构。这种比较引起人们对连接的关注，而不是木材、钢材或距离。读者通过桥梁的这一选定特征来理解论点。如果他们试图应用实际桥梁的每个属性，他们就会误解这个句子。有用的比较突出了一种关系，同时将其他特征放在一边。

cloze_122.source: A pronoun can make a sentence shorter while making its reference less clear. When two researchers discuss their results, a sentence using 'she' may leave readers unsure about which researcher performed the action. In this example, both members of the pair are referred to as she. The writer can repeat one surname to remove the uncertainty. This small repetition may be more helpful than a shorter sentence. The relevant question is whether readers can identify the person from the available wording, not whether a pronoun always saves space.
cloze_122.translation: 代词可以使句子更短，同时使其指称不太清楚。当两名研究人员讨论他们的结果时，使用“她”的句子可能会让读者不确定是哪位研究人员执行了该操作。在此示例中，该对的两个成员都被称为“她”。作者可以重复一个姓氏以消除不确定性。这个小的重复可能比较短的句子更有帮助。相关的问题是读者是否可以从可用的措辞中识别出这个人，而不是代词是否总是节省空间。

cloze_123.source: Two sentences can describe the same event while starting with different participants. In one version, the curator moved the painting; in another, the painting was moved by the curator, placing different information at the beginning. The first version starts with the person who acted. The second starts with the object affected by the action. Both identify the curator, so neither hides who did the work. A writer might choose between them according to what the previous sentence discussed and what the next sentence needs to develop.
cloze_123.translation: 两个句子可以描述同一事件，但从不同的参与者开始。一种说法是“策展人移动了这幅画”；另一种说法是“这幅画被策展人移动了”，句子开头放的信息各不相同。第一个版本从行动者开始。第二个从受操作影响的对象开始。两者都明确了策展人的身份，因此都没有隐藏是谁完成了这项工作。作者可以根据前一句讨论的内容和下一句需要发展的内容在它们之间进行选择。

cloze_124.source: A summary reduces a longer explanation while preserving its main point. A student may summarize an explanation in different words while keeping its central meaning and naming the person who originally presented it. Replacing a few words is not enough if the result changes the relationship between the ideas. For example, a claim that something may happen should not become a claim that it always happens. Identifying the source also lets a reader distinguish the student's contribution from the ideas being reported. Exact quotations serve a different purpose.
cloze_124.translation: 摘要减少了较长的解释，同时保留了其要点。学生可以用不同的词语总结解释，同时保留其中心含义并指出最初提出它的人。如果结果改变了思想之间的关系，仅仅替换几个词是不够的。例如，某事可能发生的主张不应成为该事总是会发生的主张。识别来源还可以让读者区分学生的贡献和所报告的想法。逐字引用有不同的目的。

cloze_125.source: The order in which a story is told need not match the order of its events. The narrator describes what happened before the journey began, then returns to events that occur after the travelers reach their destination. A memory of a forgotten ticket, for instance, may appear after a scene at the final station. Readers must use time expressions and verb forms to place that memory earlier in the sequence. Its position on the page tells them when it is revealed, not necessarily when it took place.
cloze_125.translation: 讲述故事的顺序不必与其事件的顺序相匹配。叙述者描述了旅程开始前发生的事情，然后回到旅行者到达目的地后发生的事件。例如，在终点站的一个场景之后，可能会出现一张被遗忘的车票的记忆。读者必须使用时间表达和动词形式将记忆放在序列的前面。它在页面上的位置告诉他们它是何时被揭示的，而不一定是何时发生的。

cloze_126.source: Knowing a word's definition does not always show where people normally use it. A dictionary may mark one meaning as formal and another as informal, helping readers decide whether either sense suits their intended audience. These labels concern the setting and relationship between speakers or writers and their audience. An expression appropriate in a relaxed message to a friend may sound unusual in an official letter. That difference does not make the expression meaningless or grammatically wrong. It shows why choosing a word involves more than matching a basic definition.
cloze_126.translation: 知道一个词的定义并不总能表明人们通常在哪里使用它。字典可能会将一种含义标记为正式含义，将另一种含义标记为非正式含义，帮助读者确定这两种含义是否适合其目标受众。这些标签涉及演讲者或作者与其听众之间的环境和关系。适合在给朋友的轻松信息中使用的表达方式在正式信件中可能听起来很不寻常。这种差异并不会使该表达变得毫无意义或语法错误。它说明了为什么选择一个单词不仅仅涉及匹配基本定义。

cloze_127.source: Combining two membership lists requires care when some names appear on both. Some students belong to both clubs, so adding the membership totals would count these people twice unless we subtracted the overlap once. Imagine that a music club has twenty members and a film club has fifteen, with five people in both. Together, the clubs include thirty different people, not thirty-five. The difference comes from counting individuals rather than counting each club membership separately. Keeping the overlap visible prevents the combined list from suggesting a larger group than actually exists.
cloze_127.translation: 当某些名字出现在两个成员名单上时，需要小心合并两个成员名单。有些学生同时属于两个俱乐部，因此将会员总数相加会将这些人计算两次，除非我们减去一次重叠部分。想象一下，一个音乐俱乐部有 20 名成员，一个电影俱乐部有 15 名成员，其中有 5 人同时参加两个俱乐部。这些俱乐部共有三十名不同的人，而不是三十五人。差异来自于计算个人而不是单独计算每个俱乐部会员。保持重叠可见可以防止合并名单给人一种人数比实际更多的错觉。

cloze_128.source: Rounding at different stages of a calculation can produce different reported totals. A student rounds separate measurements before adding them, while another adds the original values and rounds only the final total. Suppose three lengths are each one point four units. Rounding each length to the nearest whole unit gives three units altogether. Adding the original lengths gives four point two units, which rounds to four. Neither procedure can be understood without knowing when rounding occurred. A clear report states that choice so readers can follow the calculation.
cloze_128.translation: 在计算的不同阶段进行舍入可能会产生不同的报告总数。一名学生在相加之前对单独的测量值进行四舍五入，而另一名学生则将原始值相加并仅对最终总数进行四舍五入。假设三个长度各为一点四单位。将每个长度四舍五入到最接近的整数单位总共得到三个单位。将原始长度相加得到四点二单位，四舍五入为四。如果不知道何时发生舍入，则无法理解这两个过程。一份清晰的报告指出了这一选择，以便读者可以遵循计算。

cloze_129.source: A table can show visitor counts for several weeks in the same compact space. Each row represents one week, whereas separate columns record how many visitors entered on each day from Monday through Friday. Reading across follows the five weekdays within a single week. Reading down compares the same weekday in different weeks. The headings keep these two comparisons distinct. A large number in one cell means little until the reader checks both its row and its column. The table leaves weekend counts outside this particular display.
cloze_129.translation: 表格可以显示同一紧凑空间内几周内的访客数量。每行代表一周，而单独的列记录从周一到周五每天进入的访客数量。横向阅读可以查看一周内的五个工作日。向下阅读比较不同星期的同一工作日。标题使这两种比较截然不同。一个单元格中的大量数字意义不大，除非读者检查其行和列。该表将周末计数保留在该特定显示之外。

cloze_130.source: Perimeter is the distance around the boundary of a flat shape. Two rectangles can have equal perimeters but enclose different areas, because the same total length can be arranged into different side lengths. One rectangle six units long and two units wide has a perimeter of sixteen units and an area of twelve square units. A square with sides of four units also has a perimeter of sixteen, but its area is sixteen square units. Measuring the boundary therefore answers a different question from measuring the space inside it.
cloze_130.translation: 周长是围绕平面形状边界的距离。两个矩形可以具有相同的周长但包围不同的面积，因为相同的总长度可以排列成不同的边长。一个长方形，长 6 个单位，宽 2 个单位，周长为 16 个单位，面积为 12 个平方单位。边长为 4 个单位的正方形的周长也为 16，但其面积为 16 个平方单位。因此，测量边界与测量边界内部的空间所回答的问题不同。

cloze_131.source: Selecting a group and arranging that group's activities are different tasks. Choosing guest speakers for an event differs from deciding which person speaks first, since rearranging the same people changes their speaking order. Invited guests Ali, Bea, and Chen remain the same group when their names are listed differently. A program placing Bea first instead of last, however, gives the audience a different sequence. The organizer must therefore know whether the task concerns membership or order. Two lists with identical names may answer the first question equally but answer the second differently.
cloze_131.translation: 选择一个小组和安排该小组的活动是不同的任务。选择活动的演讲嘉宾与决定谁先发言不同，因为重新安排相同的人会改变他们的发言顺序。受邀嘉宾 Ali、Bea 和 Chen 即使名字的排列顺序不同，但仍属于同一组。然而，将 Bea 放在第一位而不是最后一位的节目给观众带来了不同的顺序。因此，组织者必须知道任务是否涉及小组成员的选择还是排列顺序。两个具有相同名称的列表可能会同等地回答第一个问题，但会不同地回答第二个问题。

cloze_132.source: Consider repeated throws of a fair six-sided die under the same conditions. Each new throw is independent of earlier throws, so the probability of any particular face does not change just because the previous result was unusual. A run of sixes does not make a different face due next. Independence means that earlier results do not alter the probabilities for the next throw. It does not mean that every short run must contain equal numbers of all six faces. That distinction separates an unchanged chance from a guaranteed pattern.
cloze_132.translation: 考虑在相同条件下重复抛出一个公平的六面骰子。每个新的投掷都独立于之前的投掷，因此任何特定面的概率不会仅仅因为之前的结果不寻常而改变。连续掷出六，并不意味着下一次就该轮到其他点数。独立性意味着较早的结果不会改变下一次投掷的概率。这并不意味着每一小段投掷中六个点数都必须出现同样多次。这种区别将不变的机会与有保证的模式区分开来。

cloze_133.source: At one tutoring center, students send a short note before meeting a tutor. A tutor reads the questions before each appointment. This lets her prepare examples that address the student's actual difficulty instead of repeating an entire lesson. A note saying that a student cannot interpret a graph calls for a different starting point from a note about an arithmetic error. The note need not contain a polished explanation. Even a marked page and one precise question can show where the student stopped understanding and help focus the conversation.
cloze_133.translation: 在一个辅导中心，学生在与导师会面之前发送一条简短的信息。每次预约前，导师都会阅读问题。这让她可以准备解决学生实际困难的示例，而不是重复整个课程。说明学生无法解释图表的注释需要与有关算术错误的注释不同的起点。该注释不需要包含精美的解释。即使是标记的一页和一个精确的问题也可以显示学生在哪里停止理解并帮助集中对话。

cloze_134.source: One campus uses separate systems for reserving a studio and unlocking its door. A reservation saves the room for an activity, but it does not automatically grant entry to someone who lacks the required card. A club leader may therefore see a confirmed booking while still needing to arrange access for a guest instructor. The confirmation message explains both steps and names the office responsible for each. This helps the organizer distinguish an available space from permission to enter it and complete the remaining step before the event begins.
cloze_134.translation: 一个校园使用单独的系统来预订工作室和解锁其门。预订可以为活动保留房间，但不会自动允许没有所需卡的人进入。因此，俱乐部负责人可能会看到已确认的预订，但仍需要安排客座教练的访问。确认消息解释了这两个步骤，并列出了负责每个步骤的办公室名称。这有助于组织者区分可用空间和进入权限，并在活动开始前完成剩余步骤。

cloze_135.source: A borrowed camera is easier to return complete when its accessories have clear places. The case contains several removable parts. A checklist shows where each piece belongs so borrowers can return the whole set without guessing. A charger fits in one marked pocket, and a lens cap has its own small compartment. The list stays inside the case during the loan. Before handing it back, the borrower matches each item to its place. An empty pocket then signals something specific to look for rather than a vague feeling that something is missing.
cloze_135.translation: 当借来的相机的配件有清晰的位置时，更容易完整归还。该箱子包含多个可拆卸部件。清单显示了每件物品的所属位置，因此借用者可以归还整套物品而无需猜测。充电器可放入一个带标记的口袋中，镜头盖有自己的小隔层。借阅期间，该清单保留在箱子内。在归还之前，借阅者将每件物品都匹配到它的位置。口袋空了就意味着需要寻找一些特定的东西，而不是一种模糊的感觉缺少东西。

cloze_136.source: A volunteer desk uses a brief written handover whenever one shift replaces another. The outgoing volunteer notes what has been finished and what still needs attention. After reading this record, the next person can begin with the unfinished work. For example, a visitor may have requested a map that has not yet arrived from storage. Recording that request prevents it from being forgotten when the original volunteer leaves. The note includes the current status and the next action, so the new volunteer can continue a task without starting the conversation again.
cloze_136.translation: 每当一个班次更换另一个班次时，志愿者服务台都会使用简短的书面交接表。即将离任的志愿者会记录已经完成的工作以及仍需要注意的工作。读完这个记录后，下一个人就可以开始未完成的工作了。例如，访问者可能请求了尚未从库房取来的地图。记录该请求可以防止原始志愿者离开时被遗忘。该注释包括当前状态和下一步操作，因此新志愿者可以继续任务而无需再次开始对话。

cloze_137.source: A museum team rehearses a new tour while the galleries are still empty. Guides practice the route with colleagues before visitors arrive. They check whether explanations can be heard from different positions rather than assuming everyone will stand beside the speaker. One guide gives the explanation while the others spread out where a group might naturally stop. A display case or doorway may affect the arrangement. The team can then adjust where the guide stands and when the group moves. This rehearsal turns a written tour plan into a sequence that people can actually follow.
cloze_137.translation: 当画廊仍然空着的时候，博物馆团队正在排练新的参观。在游客到达之前，导游会与同事一起练习路线。他们检查是否可以从不同的位置听到解释，而不是假设每个人都会站在演讲者旁边。一名导游给出解释，而其他人则分散到一群人可能自然停下来的地方。展示柜或门口可能会影响布置。然后，团队可以调整导游站立的位置以及团队移动的时间。这次排练将书面的旅行计划变成了人们可以实际遵循的顺序。

cloze_138.source: Packing a bag for a field trip involves deciding how to reach things later. Before leaving, students arrange their equipment according to when they expect to use it, keeping frequently needed items within easy reach. A notebook and pencil go into an outside pocket, while spare clothing stays deeper inside. If rain is expected, jackets remain near the opening. This arrangement reduces the need to unpack everything at each stop. The best location for an object depends partly on its size, but also on the sequence of activities planned for the day.
cloze_138.translation: 为实地考察收拾行李需要决定稍后如何取东西。离开之前，学生们根据预计使用的时间安排设备，将经常需要的物品放在触手可及的地方。笔记本和铅笔可放入外面的口袋中，而备用衣服则留在里面较深处。如果预计会下雨，夹克应留在开口附近。这种安排减少了在每个站点打开所有物品的需要。物体的最佳位置部分取决于其大小，还取决于当天计划的活动顺序。

cloze_139.source: A metal handle and a wooden handle can reach the same temperature in a cool room. The metal often feels colder because it draws heat from the hand more quickly than the wood does, even when their measured temperatures match. The skin responds to heat moving away, so touch reflects an exchange of energy. A thermometer checks temperature, while the hand experiences its interaction with the surface. Replacing a handle's material can therefore change how contact feels without changing the room's temperature. The comparison assumes both handles are cooler than the hand.
cloze_139.translation: 金属手柄和木手柄在阴凉的房间里可以达到相同的温度。金属通常感觉更冷，因为它比木材更快地从手上吸收热量，即使它们测量的温度匹配。皮肤会对热量的散去做出反应，因此触摸反映了能量的交换。温度计检查温度，而手则体验与表面的相互作用。因此，更换手柄的材料可以在不改变房间温度的情况下改变接触感觉。该比较假设两个手柄都比手凉爽。

cloze_140.source: A paper towel can become wet higher up than the part dipped into a cup. Water spreads through narrow spaces between the fibers even above the surface of the water. This movement depends on attraction between water and paper, together with attraction among water molecules. This process is called capillary action. The towel's internal spaces let water travel beyond the point of contact. Gravity still matters: the liquid does not rise without limit. The same process helps the towel collect a spill from a flat surface.
cloze_140.translation: 纸巾浸入杯中后，水可以润湿比浸水部分更高的位置。水通过纤维之间的狭窄空间扩散，甚至在水面上方。这种运动取决于水和纸之间的吸引力以及水分子之间的吸引力。这个过程称为毛细作用。纸巾的内部空间让水流过接触点。重力仍然很重要：液体不会无限制地上升。同样的过程可以帮助纸巾收集平坦表面上的溢出物。

cloze_141.source: Salt can stop being visible in water without ceasing to be present. The crystals break apart as their particles spread among water molecules, forming a solution that looks clear even though the salt remains. If the water later evaporates, salt crystals can form again in the container. This recovery shows why the absence of visible grains is not evidence that the salt has been destroyed. A clear liquid may contain dissolved material that cannot be distinguished by sight alone. Appearance gives only part of the information about what the liquid contains.
cloze_141.translation: 盐可以在水中不再可见，但不会停止存在。当晶体的颗粒在水分子中扩散时，晶体就会破裂，形成一种看起来清澈的溶液，尽管盐仍然存在。如果水随后蒸发，容器中会再次形成盐晶体。这种恢复表明为什么没有可见颗粒并不能证明盐已被破坏。透明液体可能含有仅通过视觉无法区分的溶解物质。外观仅提供有关液体所含成分的部分信息。

cloze_142.source: Water initially at room temperature can circulate when a pot is heated from below. The warmer water expands and rises, while cooler water moves down to replace it, carrying heat as the liquid circulates around the pot. This movement is called convection. A little dye can make the moving paths easier to see. Warmed water becomes less dense than the cooler water beside it, which helps it rise. The process transfers energy through movement of the liquid itself; it is more than heat passing directly between neighboring particles.
cloze_142.translation: 当从下面加热锅时，最初处于室温的水可以循环。较热的水膨胀并上升，而较冷的水向下移动以取代它，当液体在锅周围循环时携带热量。这种运动称为对流。一点点染料可以使移动的路径更容易看到。温暖的水的密度比旁边较冷的水的密度小，这有助于它上升。该过程通过液体本身的运动来传递能量；它不仅仅是直接在相邻粒子之间传递的热量。

cloze_143.source: Some bridges include joints designed to accommodate changes in the length of their materials. As temperatures rise, steel sections expand. Small gaps allow this movement without forcing neighboring sections against each other, reducing stress within the structure. These spaces between steel sections are planned features rather than missing pieces of construction. In cooler conditions, contraction can make the openings wider again. The appropriate design depends on the material, the length of each section, and the temperature changes expected at the site. A rigid-looking structure can therefore include controlled movement.
cloze_143.translation: 一些桥梁的接头旨在适应材料长度的变化。随着温度升高，各段钢构件膨胀。小间隙允许这种移动，而不会迫使相邻部分相互抵触，从而减少结构内的应力。钢构件之间的这些空间是规划的特征，而不是缺失的建筑部件。在较冷的条件下，收缩可以使开口再次变宽。适当的设计取决于材料、每个部分的长度以及现场预期的温度变化。因此，看起来刚性的结构可以包括受控的运动。

cloze_144.source: A lever can exchange a longer movement for a smaller applied force. Applying the effort farther from the pivot can make lifting easier, provided the load stays at its original distance from that pivot. The point where the lever turns is called its pivot. On the longer side, a hand must travel farther to lift the load through the same height. In an ideal lever, the reduced force does not mean less total work: the extra distance compensates for it. This tradeoff explains why the place where force is applied matters.
cloze_144.translation: 杠杆可以将较长的运动换成较小的作用力。如果负载与枢轴保持原来的距离，则在距离枢轴更远的地方施加作用力可以使提升变得更容易。杠杆转动的点称为其枢轴。在较长的一侧，手必须移动更远才能将负载提升到相同的高度。在理想的杠杆中，减小的力并不意味着总做功减少：额外的距离可以对其进行补偿。这种权衡解释了为什么施加力的位置很重要。

cloze_145.source: Earth's tilted axis helps explain why its two halves have opposite seasons. When northern regions lean toward the Sun, sunlight strikes them more directly and days are longer, while southern regions experience winter. Half a year later, the situation reverses. The planet's axis keeps nearly the same orientation as Earth moves around the Sun, so each hemisphere receives a changing angle and duration of sunlight. The main cause is tilt rather than Earth's changing distance from the Sun. This geometry connects a yearly journey in space with familiar changes in daylight.
cloze_145.translation: 地球的倾斜轴有助于解释为什么它的两半有相反的季节。当北方地区向太阳倾斜时，阳光会更直接地照射到它们，白天也会更长，而南方地区则经历冬天。半年后，情况发生逆转。当地球绕太阳运行时，行星的轴几乎保持相同的方向，因此每个半球接收到的阳光的角度和持续时间都在变化。主要原因是倾斜而不是地球与太阳距离的变化。这种几何形状将每年的太空旅行与熟悉的日光变化联系起来。

cloze_146.source: A comet's tail does not simply follow its motion like a ribbon behind a bicycle. The gas tail points away from the Sun because charged particles are carried outward by the solar wind, even as the comet follows its curved path. Solar wind is a stream of particles flowing from the Sun. A separate dust tail may curve more noticeably. Comparing a tail with the comet's position therefore involves its direction of travel and the direction away from the Sun. These directions need not match, so motion alone cannot explain the tail's alignment.
cloze_146.translation: 彗星的尾巴并不像自行车后面的丝带那样简单地跟随它的运动。气体尾部指向远离太阳的方向，因为带电粒子被太阳风携带向外，即使彗星遵循其弯曲的路径。太阳风是从太阳流出的粒子流。单独的尘埃尾巴可能会弯曲得更明显。因此，将彗尾与彗星的位置进行比较涉及到彗星的行进方向和远离太阳的方向。这些方向不需要匹配，因此仅靠运动无法解释尾巴的对齐方式。

cloze_147.source: Looking at a distant star also means seeing light that has spent time traveling. The image shows how the star appeared when its light began the journey, rather than how it looks at present. For a star ten light-years away, the light reaching Earth now left roughly ten years earlier. A light-year is a distance: the distance light covers in a year. This delay is a consequence of the finite speed of light. It does not require a telescope to store an old picture; the arriving light itself carries information from the past.
cloze_147.translation: 看着遥远的星星也意味着看到了经过时间传播的光。该图像显示了恒星的光开始旅程时的样子，而不是它现在的样子。对于十光年外的一颗恒星来说，现在到达地球的光大约在十年前就离开了那颗恒星。光年是一段距离：光一年所走过的距离。这种延迟是光速有限的结果。它不需要望远镜来存储旧照片；到达的光本身携带着来自过去的信息。

cloze_148.source: A planet can reveal its presence by briefly passing across the face of its star. When its orbit carries it between the star and Earth, the planet blocks some starlight and causes the observed brightness to drop. This event is called a transit. Astronomers measure the dip in a graph of brightness over time. Repeated dips can reveal how often the planet completes an orbit. The method works only when the viewing direction lets the planet cross the star from our perspective; many orbital arrangements do not produce a visible transit.
cloze_148.translation: 行星可以通过短暂地掠过其恒星的表面来揭示它的存在。当它的轨道将其带到恒星和地球之间时，行星会阻挡一些星光并导致观测到的亮度下降。这种现象称为凌星。天文学家从亮度随时间变化的图线上测量下降幅度。反复的下降可以揭示行星完成轨道运行的频率。只有当从我们所在的方向看去，行星会经过恒星前方时，该方法才有效。许多轨道安排不会产生可见的凌星现象。

cloze_149.source: A familiar star pattern is a view of objects spread through three-dimensional space. Stars that appear close together may actually lie at very different distances from Earth. Their apparent pattern depends on where we observe them. Imagine lamps placed at different depths in a room. From one doorway they can seem to outline a shape that breaks apart when viewed from the side. The analogy shows why a familiar outline in the night sky does not by itself establish that its stars are physical neighbors. A flat pattern can hide differences in depth.
cloze_149.translation: 熟悉的星形图案是散布在三维空间中的物体的视图。看似靠得很近的恒星实际上距地球的距离可能相差很大。它们的视觉图案取决于我们观察它们的位置。想象一下，灯放置在房间的不同深度。从一个门口看，它们似乎可以勾勒出一种从侧面看时会破裂的形状。这个类比说明了为什么夜空中熟悉的轮廓本身并不能证明它的星星是在空间中真的彼此相邻。平面图案可以隐藏深度差异。

cloze_150.source: Some meteor showers return at roughly the same time in successive years. A shower occurs when Earth passes through debris left along the orbit of another body, bringing many small particles into the atmosphere. The pieces produce bright streaks as they enter the air at high speed. Many showers come from comet debris, although some are linked to asteroids. The returning date reflects Earth's repeated passage through the stream. It does not require the comet itself to pass close to Earth each year. The planet meets material left on an earlier journey.
cloze_150.translation: 有些流星雨连续几年大致在同一时间返回。当地球穿过另一个天体轨道上留下的碎片时，就会发生流星雨，将许多小颗粒带入大气层。这些碎片高速进入空气时会产生明亮的条纹。许多流星雨来自彗星碎片，尽管有些流星雨与小行星有关。返回日期反映了地球反复穿过碎片流的情况。它并不要求彗星本身每年都靠近地球。地球遇到了早期旅程中留下的物质。

cloze_151.source: Artists sometimes study the empty areas around an object as carefully as the object itself. The space between curved handles may form an outline that helps artists judge proportion without naming the object they see. Instead of beginning with two cups, a student sketches the shape of the gap between their handles. The gap narrows when the cups move closer and widens when they move apart. Comparing its edges gives the student another way to organize the composition. The unfilled part of the picture becomes something with its own shape and size.
cloze_151.translation: 艺术家有时会像研究物体本身一样仔细地研究物体周围的空白区域。弯曲手柄之间的空间可以形成一个轮廓，帮助艺术家判断比例，而无需命名他们所看到的物体。学生不是从两个杯子开始，而是画出两个杯子手柄之间间隙的形状。当杯子靠近时，间隙会变窄；当杯子分开时，间隙会变宽。比较其边缘为学生提供了另一种组织构图的方式。画面中未填充的部分变成了具有自己的形状和大小的东西。

cloze_152.source: A woven cloth gains its structure from threads crossing one another. Long threads run in one direction, while another thread passes over and under them to create a connected sheet of fabric. These lengthwise threads are called the warp, and the crossing thread is the weft. A simple pattern alternates over and under successive warp threads. Changing the crossing pattern can alter the visible design and surface. The finished cloth results from interlacing, rather than from gluing separate threads onto a flat base. Each strand becomes part of a larger structure through its path.
cloze_152.translation: 编织布的结构是由相互交叉的线获得的。长线沿一个方向延伸，而另一根线则在其上方和下方穿过，形成一张相连的织物。这些纵向的线称为经线，交叉的线称为纬线。简单的图案在连续的经线之上和之下交替出现。改变交叉图案可以改变可见的设计和表面。成品布料是通过交织而成的，而不是通过将单独的线粘合到平坦的底座上而产生的。每根纱线通过其路径成为更大结构的一部分。

cloze_153.source: A relief print transfers a design from a prepared surface onto paper. A carved block receives ink on its raised surfaces. When paper is pressed against it, the image appears in reverse on the sheet. The maker cuts away the areas intended to remain unprinted and leaves the printing parts higher. Because the two surfaces meet face to face, the letter R carved to read normally on the block will appear backward in the print. An artist planning text must take this reversal into account before cutting the design.
cloze_153.translation: 凸版印刷将设计从准备好的表面转移到纸张上。雕刻块的凸起表面上沾有墨水。当纸张压在其上时，图像会以相反的方式显示在纸张上。制作者切除了原本不打印的区域，并将打印部分留得更高。由于两个表面面对面，刻在版块上的字母 R 将在印刷品中向后显示。艺术家规划文本必须在切割设计之前考虑到这种逆转。

cloze_154.source: A theater cue connects a technical action to a precise moment in a performance. A stage manager waits for the final word of the speech before signaling the next change. This links lighting to an event in the performance rather than to an approximate number of seconds. If the actor pauses longer one night, the signal still follows the same spoken cue. A rehearsal gives the team time to agree on that cue and practice the response. The written plan records both the trigger and the action, such as lighting a doorway.
cloze_154.translation: 戏剧提示将技术动作与表演中的精确时刻联系起来。舞台监督等待这段台词的最后一个词，然后发出下一个变化的信号。这将灯光与表演中的事件联系起来，而不是与大约秒数联系起来。如果演员一天晚上停顿的时间更长，信号仍然遵循相同的口头提示。排练让团队有时间就该提示达成一致并练习响应。书面计划记录了触发因素和行动，例如照亮门口。

cloze_155.source: A drawing can suggest shadow without covering every part of pale paper with solid dark ink. Closely spaced lines make an area appear darker, whereas wider gaps leave more paper visible and create the impression of light. This method is called hatching. An artist can also cross one set of lines with another to build denser marks. The viewer sees differences in how much of the pale page remains exposed. Varying line direction may suggest a surface's shape, while changing the spacing changes its visual weight. The marks work together to create tone.
cloze_155.translation: 一幅图画可以暗示阴影，而无需用深色墨水覆盖苍白纸的每个部分。间隔紧密的线条使区域显得更暗，而较宽的间隙使更多的纸张可见并产生光的印象。这种方法称为排线法。艺术家还可以将一组线与另一组线交叉以构建更密集的标记。观看者会看到有多少苍白页面仍然暴露在外。改变线条方向可能会暗示表面的形状，而改变间距会改变其视觉重量。这些线条共同营造明暗色调。

cloze_156.source: Cropping a photograph changes what a viewer can use as context. The editor removes part of the original frame, leaving some details visible while others fall outside the published view. This choice can change the picture's emphasis. For example, an image of one person cheering may originally include a larger group that looks uncertain. A tighter crop can direct attention toward excitement while excluding the wider reaction. The remaining pixels need not be altered for the emphasis to change. Comparing the crop with the full image reveals what information has been removed.
cloze_156.translation: 裁剪照片会改变观看者可以用作背景的内容。图片编辑删除了原始框架的一部分，留下一些可见的细节，而其他细节则落在已发布的视图之外。此选择可以改变图片的重点。例如，一个人欢呼的图像最初可能包括一大群看起来不确定的人。裁得更紧的画面可以将注意力引向兴奋，同时排除更广泛的反应。无需改变其余像素即可改变重点。将裁剪图像与完整图像进行比较可以揭示哪些信息已被删除。

cloze_157.source: A seed can be alive without beginning to grow. Some seeds remain dormant even when moisture and warmth are available, because internal barriers must first be removed before growth can begin. In certain species, a period of cold, moist conditions helps overcome these barriers. The seed may then germinate when other requirements are met. This delay can prevent a brief warm spell from triggering growth too early in the year. Different species have different requirements, so watering alone does not necessarily make every living seed sprout.
cloze_157.translation: 一颗种子在没有开始生长的情况下也可以是活的。即使有水分和温暖，一些种子仍然处于休眠状态，因为在开始生长之前必须首先消除内部障碍。对于某些物种来说，一段时期的寒冷、潮湿的环境有助于克服这些障碍。当满足其他要求时，种子就可以发芽。这种延迟可以防止短暂的暖期在一年中过早引发萌发生长。不同的物种有不同的要求，所以仅仅浇水并不一定能让每颗活的种子发芽。

cloze_158.source: A lichen brings different kinds of organisms into a close association. The fungus forms much of the body, while green algae can make sugars by using sunlight. Together, these partners occupy places where living separately would be more difficult. The fungal layer offers protection that reduces drying around the photosynthetic cells. The association can also include other microorganisms, so the familiar two-part description is a useful starting point rather than a complete inventory. A patch on a rock therefore represents an organized partnership, not simply one tiny plant.
cloze_158.translation: 地衣将不同种类的生物体紧密结合在一起。真菌构成了身体的大部分，而绿藻可以利用阳光制造糖。这些伙伴共同占据了分开生活会更加困难的地方。真菌层提供保护，减少光合细胞周围的干燥。该关联还可以包括其他微生物，因此熟悉的两部分描述是一个有用的起点，而不是完整的清单。因此，岩石上的一小片地衣代表着一种有组织的伙伴关系，而不仅仅是一株小植物。

cloze_159.source: Earthworms can change the physical structure of cultivated ground. As worms tunnel through cultivated soil, their burrows create channels that allow water and air to move below the surface. Roots may follow some of these existing routes as they grow. The effect depends on the kinds of worms present and on the soil itself. A passage left by a worm is different from a solid block of earth because it provides open space. This explains one way that living organisms can influence water movement without directly carrying the water themselves.
cloze_159.translation: 蚯蚓可以改变耕地的物理结构。当蚯蚓穿过耕种土壤时，它们的洞穴会形成通道，使水和空气能够在地表以下移动。根在生长时可能会沿着其中一些现有路线生长。效果取决于存在的蚯蚓种类和土壤本身。蚯蚓留下的通道与固体土块不同，因为它提供了开放空间。这解释了生物体在不直接携带水的情况下影响水运动的一种方式。

cloze_160.source: Many pines keep needles through more than one growing season. A waxy coating on each needle helps limit water loss, while retained leaves can keep working when conditions are suitable. Keeping leaves means the tree does not have to replace its entire leaf supply every spring. It does not mean that an individual needle lasts forever. Older needles eventually fall, and new ones take their place. The tree can therefore look green throughout the year even as particular leaves are replaced. Retention and replacement occur on different schedules.
cloze_160.translation: 许多松树的针叶可以持续一个以上的生长季节。每片针叶上的蜡质涂层有助于限制水分流失，而保留的叶子可以在条件合适时继续工作。保留叶子意味着树不必在每年春天更换全部叶子。这并不意味着一片针叶会永远存在。老针叶最终会脱落，新的针叶会取而代之。因此，即使更换了特定的叶子，这棵树也能全年呈现绿色。保留和更换按不同的时间表进行。

cloze_161.source: A rocky shore may expose its residents as the tide falls. When water retreats, some attached barnacles become exposed to air. They close protective plates across the opening and retain moisture. Underwater, a barnacle can extend small feeding limbs to catch food carried past it. Once exposed, it faces the problem of drying instead. Closing the opening helps keep water inside until the surroundings change again. Individuals lower on the shore may remain submerged longer than those above them, so nearby animals do not necessarily face identical conditions at the same moment.
cloze_161.translation: 退潮时，岩石海岸可能会暴露其居民。当水退去时，一些附着的藤壶就会暴露在空气中。它们关闭开口处的保护板并保持水分。在水下，藤壶可以伸出细小的进食肢体来捕捉经过它的食物。一旦暴露，反而面临干燥的问题。关闭开口有助于将水保留在内部，直到周围环境再次发生变化。海岸下方的个体可能比上方的个体在水下停留的时间更长，因此附近的动物不一定会在同一时刻面临相同的情况。

cloze_162.source: The flat part of a flight feather depends on many tiny connections. Small hooks join neighboring branches so that they form one continuous surface. A bird uses its beak to guide separated branches back together during preening. This restores the smooth arrangement without requiring a new feather to grow each time a small gap appears. The structure resembles a fastening system that can be opened and joined again. Soft down feathers have a different arrangement: their loose branches trap air rather than forming the same firm, connected surface.
cloze_162.translation: 飞羽的扁平部分取决于许多微小的连接。小钩子连接相邻的羽枝，使它们形成一个连续的表面。鸟儿在梳理羽毛时用喙将分离的羽枝重新连接在一起。这会恢复平滑的排列，而不需要每次出现小间隙时都长出新的羽毛。该结构类似于一个可以打开和再次连接的紧固系统。柔软的羽绒羽毛有不同的排列方式：它们松散的羽枝会滞留空气，而不是形成同样坚固、相连的表面。

cloze_163.source: The length of a walk need not equal the separation between its endpoints. Although someone walks eight blocks east and then returns three blocks west, the distance traveled differs from the final displacement. The walk covers eleven blocks altogether. However, the person finishes only five blocks east of the starting place. Displacement describes this change in position, including its direction, rather than the entire path taken. If the walker returns all the way to the starting point, the displacement becomes zero even though the journey has covered some distance.
cloze_163.translation: 步行的长度不必等于其端点之间的距离。尽管有人向东走了八个街区，然后向西返回三个街区，但所走的距离与最终的位移不同。这条步行道总共覆盖十一个街区。然而，该人仅在起点以东五个街区处完成任务。位移描述了位置的变化，包括其方向，而不是所采取的整个路径。如果步行者一路返回到起点，即使行程已经走了一段距离，位移也会变为零。

cloze_164.source: A map can show a walking route that bends around several buildings. To measure the route, students follow each bend rather than drawing one straight line between the starting point and destination. They place a piece of string along the marked path and then straighten it beside a ruler. The map's scale converts the measured length into a ground distance. A direct connection between the endpoints would cut across places the walkers cannot pass through. The method therefore follows the available route instead of treating the journey as an unrestricted straight crossing.
cloze_164.translation: 地图可以显示绕过几座建筑物的步行路线。为了测量路线，学生顺着路线的每个转弯测量，而不是在起点和目的地之间画一条直线。他们沿着标记的路径放置一根绳子，然后在尺子旁边将其拉直。地图的比例尺将测量的长度转换为地面距离。端点之间的直接连接将跨越步行者无法通过的地方。因此，该方法遵循可用路线，而不是将旅程视为无限制的直线穿越。

cloze_165.source: Checking a schedule requires attention to both ends of an appointment. Two meetings can overlap even though their starting times differ. What matters is whether either continues after the other begins. For example, a meeting from nine to ten conflicts with one that starts at nine forty-five and ends at ten thirty. The two share fifteen minutes. Looking only at the first number in each entry hides that conflict. Marking each appointment as a bar on a timeline makes the shared period visible and helps someone decide which commitment must change.
cloze_165.translation: 检查日程安排需要注意约定事项的开始和结束时间。即使两个会议的开始时间不同，它们也可以重叠。重要的是其中一个是否在另一个开始后继续。例如，从九点到十点的会议与九点四十五分开始到十点三十分结束的会议冲突。两场会议有十五分钟重叠。仅查看每个条目中的第一个数字就隐藏了该冲突。将每个约会标记为时间轴上的一个栏，可以使共享时间段可见，并帮助某人决定必须调整哪项安排。

cloze_166.source: A claim about every member of a group makes a strong commitment. One exception is enough to disprove an absolute statement, provided that the example falls within its stated scope. This does not mean that any unusual case will do. If someone claims that every book in a particular room has a red cover, a blue book in that room defeats the claim. A blue book in a different building does not. The location is part of the original claim, so checking the example's membership matters as much as noticing its color.
cloze_166.translation: 声称某个群体中的每个成员都符合一种情况，是一个很强的断言。一个例外足以反驳绝对的陈述，前提是该示例属于其规定的范围。这并不意味着任何异常情况都可以。如果有人声称某个房间里的每本书都有红色封面，那么该房间里的一本蓝色书就推翻了这一说法。另一栋大楼的蓝皮书则不然。该位置是原始声明的一部分，因此检查示例的成员资格与注意其颜色一样重要。

cloze_167.source: A rectangular dot pattern can illustrate two ways to count the same collection. Each row contains four dots, and there are three rows. Turning the sheet changes their orientation but leaves the total unchanged. After a quarter turn, the viewer sees four rows with three dots in each. Both arrangements contain twelve dots. Nothing has been added or removed; only the direction from which the rows are read has changed. The pattern makes the equality of three times four and four times three visible without requiring two separate collections of objects.
cloze_167.translation: 矩形点图案可以说明对同一集合进行计数的两种方法。每行包含四个点，共有三行。转动纸张会改变它们的方向，但总数保持不变。四分之一圈后，观察者会看到四行，每行三个点。两种排列都包含十二个点。没有添加或删除任何内容；仅读取行的方向发生了变化。该模式使三乘四和四乘三的相等性可见，而不需要两个单独的对象集合。

cloze_168.source: A weekly calendar repeats its sequence after seven complete days. An event repeated every seven days falls on the same weekday, whereas an interval of eight days moves it forward one weekday each time. For instance, an eight-day cycle starting on Monday next lands on Tuesday. The extra day carries the event beyond one full week. Counting several cycles therefore requires tracking the remainder after complete weeks are removed. A recurring activity need not stay on a fixed weekday simply because its interval remains constant.
cloze_168.translation: 周历每过完整的七天就重复一次。每隔七天发生的活动，总落在同一个星期几；每隔八天的活动，则每次都在上一次的基础上往后推一天。例如，第一次在周一，八天后的下一次就在周二。多出的这一天使活动越过了整整一周。因此，计算多个周期时，需要先扣除完整的周数，再看余下几天。即使活动间隔固定，反复举行的活动也不一定总在每周的同一天。

cloze_169.source: A list of notes does not automatically reveal how an argument is organized. An outline places major claims above supporting points, so the reader can see which ideas belong together and how they relate. A writer might place a proposal at the top, reasons beneath it, and examples under each reason. If an example has no clear connection to its heading, its position needs reconsideration. The arrangement is therefore more than a plan for paragraph order. It also tests whether the smaller parts actually support the larger statements they are meant to explain.
cloze_169.translation: 注释列表不会自动揭示论证的组织方式。大纲将主要主张放在支持点之上，这样读者就可以看到哪些想法属于同一组以及它们如何相互关联。作者可能会将提案放在顶部，将理由放在其下方，并在每个理由下方放置示例。如果一个例子与其标题没有明确的联系，那么它的位置就需要重新考虑。因此，这种安排不仅仅是段落顺序的计划。它还测试较小的部分是否真正支持它们要解释的较大的陈述。

cloze_170.source: A reader looking for one topic may not need to read a book from the beginning. An index directs readers to pages where particular subjects are discussed, rather than retelling the book in chapter order. Its entries can gather references from widely separated sections under a single subject. A topic introduced early may return much later in a different discussion. An index helps connect those locations, although it need not list every brief mention. The reader still needs to inspect the indicated pages to decide which treatment is relevant to the question at hand.
cloze_170.translation: 寻找一个主题的读者可能不需要从头开始阅读一本书。索引将读者引导至讨论特定主题的页面，而不是按章节顺序重述本书。它的条目可以从单个主题下广泛分离的部分收集参考资料。早期引入的主题可能会在很晚之后在不同的讨论中出现。索引有助于连接这些位置，尽管它不需要列出所有简短提及的内容。读者仍然需要检查指示的页面来决定哪处论述与当前的问题相关。

cloze_171.source: A page reference is most useful when another reader can locate the same version of a work. The entry identifies the edition actually consulted, since page numbers may change even when the title stays the same. This detail helps explain why a quotation on page forty in one copy might appear elsewhere in another. A revised edition may add a preface or rearrange material. Recording the version does not prove that the argument is correct; it gives readers a clearer route to the evidence used in making it.
cloze_171.translation: 当其他读者可以找到同一版本的作品时，页面引用是最有用的。该条目标识了实际查阅的版本，因为即使标题保持不变，页码也可能会发生变化。这一细节有助于解释为什么一份副本中第 40 页的引述可能会出现在另一份副本的其他地方。修订版可能会添加序言或重新安排材料。记录版本并不能证明该论证是正确的；它为读者提供了更清晰的途径来获取提出论证时所用的证据。

cloze_172.source: Leaving words out of a quotation can change the strength of a claim. An ellipsis marks words left out of an original quotation, but it does not authorize changing what the speaker meant. Imagine someone saying, 'I support the plan if buses remain free.' Removing the condition could turn limited support into unconditional agreement. The three dots signal an omission, yet they do not explain what has disappeared. A careful editor therefore checks the shortened wording against the full statement, especially when the missing section contains a qualification, contrast, or requirement.
cloze_172.translation: 从引文中删除文字可能会改变主张的强度。省略号标记了原始引文中遗漏的单词，但它并不授权改变说话者的意思。想象一下有人说：“如果公交车保持免费，我支持该计划。”取消该条件可能会将有限的支持转变为无条件同意。这三个点表示遗漏，但它们并没有解释消失的内容。因此，细心的编辑会根据完整的陈述检查缩短的措辞，尤其是当缺失的部分包含限定、对比或要求时。

cloze_173.source: An actor places a guest's written reply where the spectators can see it. The audience knows that a reply has arrived, although another character still believes nobody has answered. This difference creates tension when the uninformed character prepares to cancel the gathering. Viewers can anticipate a misunderstanding that the character cannot yet recognize. The scene may become comic or serious depending on the consequences. The key relationship concerns unequal information, regardless of whether the reply accepts or declines the earlier invitation.
cloze_173.translation: 演员将客人的书面回复放在观众可以看到的地方。观众知道回复已经到达，尽管另一个角色仍然相信没有人回复。当不知情的角色准备取消聚会时，这种差异会产生紧张气氛。观众可以预见到角色尚未认识到的误解。根据后果，场景可能会变得滑稽或严肃。关键关系涉及不平等的信息，无论回复是接受还是拒绝先前的邀请。

cloze_174.source: Two neighboring paragraphs can perform different jobs in a report. The first paragraph describes the problem, whereas the next explores possible responses. This shift tells readers that the writer has moved from explaining a situation to considering action. In a report about traffic noise, the opening paragraph might identify the busiest hours. The next could compare changes to delivery schedules or road surfaces. A transition helps readers follow that change in purpose. It does not, by itself, establish that any proposed response will work; the discussion must still explain each option's likely effects.
cloze_174.translation: 报告中两个相邻的段落可以执行不同的工作。第一段描述了问题，而下一段则探讨了可能的应对措施。这种转变告诉读者，作者已经从解释情况转向考虑采取行动。在有关交通噪音的报告中，开头段落可能会指出最繁忙的时间。接下来可以比较送货时间表或路面的变化。过渡可以帮助读者跟随目的的变化。它本身并不表明任何提议的应对措施都会起作用；讨论仍然必须解释每个选项可能产生的影响。

cloze_175.source: An echo is sound reflected back toward the place where it began. The sound travels toward the wall before returning to its source. The measured delay therefore includes both outward and return journeys. To estimate the wall's distance, a student multiplies the delay by the speed of sound under the classroom conditions and divides the result by two. Without that final division, the result describes the whole trip. The calculation assumes that the sound is received where it was produced and that the reflecting surface is the wall being measured.
cloze_175.translation: 回声是声音反射回其开始的地方。声音向墙壁传播，然后返回源头。因此，测量的延误包括去程和回程旅程。为了估计墙的距离，学生将延迟乘以教室条件下的声速，然后将结果除以二。如果没有最后这一步除以二，结果就描述了整个旅程。计算假设声音在产生声音的地方被接收，并且反射表面是被测量的墙壁。

cloze_176.source: A simple pendulum offers a way to compare the roles of length and mass. With small swings, lengthening the string makes each complete cycle take longer, while changing the mass alone does not alter its period in the ideal model. Here, a cycle means one full movement out and back to the same position and direction. The comparison uses pendulums at the same location, where gravity is effectively unchanged. Real strings and air resistance introduce additional effects, but the simple model explains why adjusting length is a useful way to change the timing.
cloze_176.translation: 一个简单的摆提供了一种比较长度和质量作用的方法。对于小摆动，延长弦会使每个完整周期花费更长的时间，而仅改变质量并不会改变理想模型中的周期。这里，一个循环意味着一次完整的运动来回相同的位置和方向。该比较使用同一位置的摆锤，其中重力实际上没有变化。实际的摆线和空气阻力会带来额外的影响，但简单的模型解释了为什么调整长度是改变时间的有效方法。

cloze_177.source: A security mirror that bulges outward can show a broad area of a room. The curved surface produces smaller images than those seen in flat mirrors, so visitors can observe several aisles at once. This wider view is useful at a corner where a direct line of sight is blocked. The benefit comes with a change in apparent size: a small reflection does not necessarily mean that its object is far away. Someone interpreting the scene must therefore distinguish the mirror's shape from the actual layout and size of the objects being reflected.
cloze_177.translation: 向外凸出的安全镜可以显示房间的广阔区域。弯曲的表面产生的图像比平面镜中看到的图像更小，因此游客可以同时观察多个过道。这种更广阔的视野在直接视线被阻挡的角落非常有用。这种好处也伴随着视觉大小的变化：小反射并不一定意味着它的物体很远。因此，解释场景的人必须将镜子的形状与被反射物体的实际布局和大小区分开来。

cloze_178.source: A straight pencil partly immersed in water can look bent near the surface. Light changes direction when it passes at an angle from water into air, making the submerged part appear displaced from its true position. The observer interprets the arriving rays as though they had traveled straight all the way from the pencil. Their changed path therefore produces a shifted image of the underwater section. Lifting the pencil out reveals that the object itself has not bent. The difference comes from how light reaches the eye through the two materials.
cloze_178.translation: 部分浸入水中的直铅笔在表面附近看起来是弯曲的。当光线以一定角度从水中进入空气时，光线会改变方向，使淹没的部分看起来偏离了其真实位置。观察者将到达的光线解释为好像它们是从铅笔中一直直线传播的。因此，它们改变的路径会产生水下部分的移动图像。把铅笔拿出来可以发现物体本身并没有弯曲。区别在于光线如何通过两种材料到达眼睛。

cloze_179.source: A charged plastic comb can attract a tiny piece of paper that is electrically neutral overall. Its electric field slightly shifts charges within the paper so that opposite charges lie nearer than similar ones. This attraction can lift a light scrap. The nearer attraction is stronger than the repulsion from charges of the same sign farther away. The paper can remain neutral overall even as positive and negative charge are distributed unevenly within it. This rearrangement explains why attraction alone does not establish that the paper began with a net charge opposite to the comb's.
cloze_179.translation: 带电的塑料梳子可以吸引一张整体呈电中性的小纸片。它的电场会稍微移动纸张内的电荷，使相反的电荷比相似的电荷更近。这种吸引力能提起轻薄的纸屑。较近的吸引力强于较远的相同符号电荷的排斥力。即使正负电荷在其中分布不均匀，纸张总体上仍能保持中性。这种重新排列解释了为什么仅靠吸引力并不能证明纸开始时带有与梳子相反的净电荷。

cloze_180.source: A classroom battery powers two small bulbs connected in a single series loop. If either bulb is removed, the single path becomes incomplete, and current stops flowing through both bulbs despite the battery still having stored energy. The second bulb does not stay lit simply because it remains in its socket. Both depend on the same continuous route through the wires and battery. Replacing the missing bulb can restore that route. This arrangement differs from one with separate branches, where opening a particular branch need not interrupt every other path.
cloze_180.translation: 教室电池为连接在单个串联回路中的两个小灯泡供电。如果任一灯泡被移除，单个路径就会变得不完整，并且电流停止流过两个灯泡，尽管电池仍然存储着能量。第二个灯泡不会仅仅因为它留在灯座中而保持点亮状态。两者都依赖于通过电线和电池的相同连续路线。更换丢失的灯泡可以恢复该路线。这种布置与具有单独分支的布置不同，在这种布置中，断开某条支路不一定会中断所有其他通路。

cloze_181.source: A campus desk posts a general description of a bracelet found near the library. The owner must describe some detail that is not visible in the public notice, such as an inscription inside the item. The staff keep the exact wording of the engraved message off the notice. A person claiming the bracelet can then supply that information without simply copying the advertisement. If the description matches, staff continue the desk's return procedure. Publishing every detail would make the initial comparison less useful, because any reader could repeat the same information.
cloze_181.translation: 校园服务台张贴了在图书馆附近发现的手镯的一般描述。所有者必须描述一些在公告中不可见的细节，例如物品内部的铭文。工作人员不会在公告中写出刻字的确切内容。然后，认领手镯的人可以提供该信息，而无需简单地复制广告。如果描述相符，工作人员将继续服务台的失物归还程序。公布每个细节将使最初的比较变得不那么有用，因为任何读者都可以重复相同的信息。

cloze_182.source: A seminar divides the work of discussion among a facilitator, a note taker, and a summarizer. Each participant receives one role for the first discussion, then exchanges it with another member before the next round. This arrangement prevents the same person from keeping a single responsibility throughout the session. After the first round, the note taker may lead while the former leader prepares the summary. The topic can continue even though the jobs change. At the end, students compare what they noticed from the different positions they occupied.
cloze_182.translation: 研讨会将讨论工作划分为协调员、记录员和总结员。每个参与者在第一次讨论中都会获得一个角色，然后在下一轮讨论之前与另一位成员交换角色。这种安排可以防止同一个人在整个会议期间承担单一责任。第一轮结束后，记录员可以领导，而前领导者准备总结。即使工作发生变化，这个话题仍然可以继续。最后，学生们比较他们从不同位置观察到的情况。

cloze_183.source: At a student theater, several seats near the back are kept empty for people who arrive after the opening. The usher asks late arrivals to wait until the current scene ends, then leads them quietly to their seats during a brief pause. Those seats are close to an aisle so newcomers can reach them with little movement across other viewers. The delay concerns the moment of entry, not the validity of the tickets. Once the scene finishes, the visitors can enter together and settle before the next section begins.
cloze_183.translation: 在学生剧院，靠近后面的几个座位都空着，供开幕后到达的人们使用。引座员要求迟到的人等到当前场景结束，然后在短暂的停顿期间安静地引导他们到座位上。这些座位靠近过道，因此新来者可以在与其他观众之间几乎不移动的情况下到达这些座位。延迟涉及的是入场时间，而不是门票的有效性。场景结束后，参观者可以一起进入并在下一个部分开始之前安顿下来。

cloze_184.source: A student swap event gives one ticket for each accepted book or small household object. An exchange ticket represents permission to choose one item, rather than the monetary value of what someone brought. This rule makes the selection process simple, but it does not guarantee that the chosen object originally cost the same amount as the donated one. Participants see the rule before deciding whether to join. Someone who brings an expensive lamp can keep it instead if receiving just one selection ticket seems unsuitable. The system depends on accepting its stated unit of exchange.
cloze_184.translation: 学生交换活动为每本接受的书籍或小家居物品提供一张兑换券。兑换券代表选择一件物品的许可，而不是某人带来的物品的货币价值。这一规则使选择过程变得简单，但并不能保证所选物品的原始价格与捐赠物品的价格相同。参与者在决定是否加入之前先查看规则。如果只收到一张选择票似乎不合适，携带昂贵灯具的人可以保留它。该系统取决于接受其规定的交换单位。

cloze_185.source: A campus lecture attracts more people than the main hall can seat. The organizers reserve another room where visitors can watch the event on a screen, but they explain that seats there do not include a place in the main hall's question line. Questions from the second room must be written on cards and collected during the break. The separate arrangement expands viewing space while changing how people participate. A sign at the entrance describes both features, allowing arriving visitors to choose the room with a clear understanding of what it offers.
cloze_185.translation: 校园讲座吸引的人数超过了主厅所能容纳的人数。组织者预留了另一个房间，游客可以在屏幕上观看活动，但他们解释说，那里的座位不包括主厅提问队列中的位置。第二个房间的问题必须写在卡片上并在休息期间收集。单独的布置扩大了观看空间，同时改变了人们的参与方式。入口处的标志描述了这两个功能，让到达的游客可以在清楚了解房间提供的服务的情况下选择房间。

cloze_186.source: A campus club uses a form that separates preparing an application from sending it. A draft remains editable until the applicant presses the submit button, after which the system issues a receipt. Saving alone does not place the application in the club's review queue. This distinction lets someone gather missing information over several visits without sending an incomplete request. The receipt records when the completed form was received; it does not promise acceptance into the club. Applicants can use it to confirm that the submission step actually occurred.
cloze_186.translation: 校园俱乐部使用一种表格将准备申请与发送申请分开。草稿保持可编辑状态，直到申请人按下提交按钮，之后系统会发出回执。单独保存并不会将申请放入俱乐部的审核队列中。这种区别使某人可以在多次访问中收集缺失的信息，而无需发送不完整的请求。回执记录完整表格的接收时间，但不保证申请人获准加入俱乐部。申请人可以用它来确认提交步骤确实发生了。

cloze_187.source: A typical pond tadpole changes much more than its size as it becomes a frog. The young animal develops legs while its tail gradually shrinks, and its body absorbs the remaining tissue rather than simply shedding the tail. Changes inside the animal accompany the visible transformation, including the development of lungs. The resulting frog can move and breathe in ways the early tadpole could not. The process is called metamorphosis. Its timing varies with the species and growing conditions, so photographs of different individuals need not show exactly the same stage after an equal number of days.
cloze_187.translation: 当一只典型的池塘蝌蚪变成青蛙时，其变化远不止其大小。幼小的动物会长出腿，而尾巴则逐渐缩小，它的身体会吸收剩余的组织，而不是简单地脱落尾巴。动物体内的变化伴随着可见的转变，包括肺部的发育。由此产生的青蛙可以以早期蝌蚪无法做到的方式移动和呼吸。这个过程称为变态。它的时间因物种和生长条件而异，因此不同个体的照片不需要在相同天数后显示完全相同的阶段。

cloze_188.source: A bat's wing is built around a greatly modified forelimb. Long finger bones support thin skin that stretches between them, forming the broad surface used for powered flight. The membrane can change shape as the animal moves its fingers and arm. A bird uses a different wing covering, with feathers contributing much of the flight surface. Looking only at the outline of an extended wing can hide this structural difference. Examining the supports and covering reveals how two flying animals use distinct arrangements of body parts to move through the air.
cloze_188.translation: 蝙蝠的翅膀是围绕经过大幅改造的前肢构建的。长指骨支撑着在它们之间伸展的薄皮肤，形成用于动力飞行的宽阔表面。当动物移动手指和手臂时，膜可以改变形状。鸟类使用不同的翅膀覆盖物，羽毛占据了大部分飞行表面。仅查看延伸翅膀的轮廓可以隐藏这种结构差异。检查支撑物和覆盖物揭示了两类会飞的动物如何利用不同的身体部位排列在空中移动。

cloze_189.source: A humpback whale breathes using lungs rather than extracting oxygen from water as a fish does. At the surface, air passes through openings on the head, allowing the animal to exchange gases before another dive. The visible cloud above the animal can form as moisture in its warm exhaled breath condenses. It is not a jet of seawater emptied from the lungs. The breathing openings close during a dive, and the whale returns to the surface to breathe again. Living in the ocean therefore does not imply using the same breathing structures as a fish.
cloze_189.translation: 座头鲸用肺呼吸，而不是像鱼那样从水中提取氧气。在水面上，空气通过头部的开口，使动物能够在下次潜水之前交换气体。当动物呼出的温暖气体中的水分凝结时，动物上方可见的云就会形成。它不是从肺部排空的一股海水。潜水期间呼吸孔关闭，鲸鱼返回水面再次呼吸。因此，生活在海洋中并不意味着使用与鱼相同的呼吸结构。

cloze_190.source: Researchers studying two kinds of orb-weaving spider examined how the animals avoid sticking to their webs. Their legs combine branching hairs with surfaces that resist adhesion, while careful movements reduce contact with sticky silk. These features work together as the spiders place their feet and lift them away. In tests, removing the protective coating made the legs adhere more strongly. The findings connect the animal's body covering with the way it moves. Describing only the coating would miss the contribution of the hairs and the controlled actions observed during web construction.
cloze_190.translation: 研究人员研究了两种圆网蜘蛛，研究了这些动物如何避免粘在网上。它们的腿将分叉的毛发与抗粘附的表面结合在一起，而小心的动作可以减少与粘性丝的接触。当蜘蛛放置脚和抬起脚时，这些功能一起发挥作用。在测试中，去除保护涂层可以使腿粘附得更牢固。研究结果将动物的身体覆盖物与其移动方式联系起来。仅描述涂层会忽略毛发的贡献以及在结网过程中观察到的受控行为。

cloze_191.source: A prickly pear cactus organizes its visible parts differently from a broad-leaved garden plant. Its green pads are modified stems, whereas the sharp spines correspond to highly modified leaves. The pads store water and use sunlight to make sugars. A pad's broad shape may resemble a leaf, but shape alone does not determine which plant part it is. The distinction changes how a diagram should be labeled: the flattened green unit is a stem segment, while the pointed structures are specialized leaves. A familiar appearance can conceal a different arrangement of parts.
cloze_191.translation: 仙人掌的可见部分的组织方式与阔叶园林植物不同。它的绿色掌状部分是经过改造的茎，而尖锐的刺对应于高度改造的叶子。这些掌状茎可以储存水并利用阳光来制造糖。掌状茎宽大的形状可能类似于叶子，但形状本身并不能决定它是植物的哪个部分。这种区别改变了图表的标记方式：扁平的绿色单元是茎段，而尖的结构是专门的叶子。熟悉的外观可能隐藏着不同的部件排列。

cloze_192.source: Some mangrove trees grow upward-pointing roots in muddy ground that is short of oxygen. These roots project above the mud, where small openings allow oxygen to enter when the tide exposes them to air. Internal passages then carry gases to parts of the root system below the surface. The unusual direction of growth helps the tree meet a problem created by waterlogged soil. Roots need oxygen for their own living cells, even though the plant's green parts can produce oxygen during photosynthesis. Different mangrove species use different root arrangements to cope with their surroundings.
cloze_192.translation: 有些红树林在缺氧的泥泞地面上长出向上的根。这些根部突出在泥土上方，当潮汐使它们暴露在空气中时，那里的小开口可以让氧气进入。然后，内部通道将气体输送到地表以下的根系部分。这种不寻常的生长方向帮助这棵树解决了土壤浸水造成的问题。尽管植物的绿色部分可以在光合作用过程中产生氧气，但根部的活细胞需要氧气。不同的红树林物种使用不同的根部排列来应对周围的环境。

cloze_193.source: A free workshop can still have a cost for a student with limited time. The cost includes what the student gives up by choosing one activity over another, even when no money changes hands. If the student's next best use of that hour would be preparing for a presentation, the missed preparation is the relevant alternative. Economists call the value of that forgone option an opportunity cost. The comparison is with the best available alternative, not with every imaginable activity added together. A zero admission price therefore leaves a real choice about how to use the hour.
cloze_193.translation: 对于时间有限的学生来说，免费研讨会仍然可能会有成本。成本包括学生因选择一项活动而不是另一项活动而放弃的东西，即使没有钱易手。如果不参加这项活动，学生这一小时最值得做的事是准备演讲，那么错过的准备就是相关的替代方案。经济学家将放弃的选择的价值称为机会成本。比较是与最佳可用替代方案进行比较，而不是与所有可以想象的活动相加。因此，零入场费让人们可以真正选择如何利用这一时间。

cloze_194.source: Preparing a printing job takes some work before the first copy is made. The initial setup cost stays constant within this printing run, whereas paper use increases with the number of copies produced. Spreading the setup charge across more copies lowers the setup cost per copy. It does not make the paper for the extra copies free. A club comparing two order sizes therefore separates the shared preparation charge from the cost of each additional sheet. The larger order can have a lower average cost while still requiring a higher total payment.
cloze_194.translation: 在制作第一份副本之前，准备打印作业需要一些工作。在此印刷过程中，初始设置成本保持不变，而纸张使用量则随着生产份数的增加而增加。将设置费用分摊到更多副本可以降低每个副本的设置成本。它不会免费提供额外份数的纸张。因此，比较两种订单大小的俱乐部将共享的准备费用与每张额外的纸张的成本分开。较大的订单可以具有较低的平均成本，但仍然需要较高的总付款。

cloze_195.source: The relationship between two goods depends on how people use them. Two products are substitutes when one can replace the other for some purpose, whereas complementary goods are used together rather than in place of each other. A pen and a pencil may be alternatives for taking handwritten notes. A pen and a compatible refill serve different roles that work together. These relationships concern a particular use, not every feature of the objects. A pencil may replace a pen for a rough draft while failing to meet a requirement that the final form be completed in ink.
cloze_195.translation: 两种商品之间的关系取决于人们如何使用它们。当一种产品可以出于某种目的替代另一种产品时，两种产品就是替代品，而互补品则一起使用而不是相互替代。钢笔和铅笔可以作为手写笔记的替代品。一支笔和一个兼容的笔芯可以发挥不同的作用，同时发挥作用。这些关系涉及特定用途，而不是对象的每个特征。铅笔可以代替钢笔来绘制草稿，但无法满足最终表格用墨水完成的要求。

cloze_196.source: Several people can learn the same information from a public notice board. One person reading the message does not remove it from the view of others, provided that there is enough space for everyone to see it. The information is not used up when someone reads it. The physical area in front of the board is different: a crowd can block additional viewers. This example distinguishes the shared content from access to a viewing position. Improving access may require moving the board or providing another copy, even though the message itself has not been consumed.
cloze_196.translation: 几个人可以从公告牌上了解到相同的信息。只要有足够的空间让每个人都能看到该消息，一个人阅读该消息并不会使其从其他人的视野中消失。当有人阅读时，信息并没有被用完。公告板前面的物理区域是不同的：人群可能会阻挡更多的观众。该示例将共享内容与对观看位置的访问区分开来。改善访问可能需要移动板或提供另一个副本，即使消息本身尚未被消耗。

cloze_197.source: Producing a student magazine involves more than writing the articles. Each editor specializes in part of the work, but the magazine still requires coordination so that separate contributions form one coherent issue. One person may check facts while another arranges photographs and a third reviews the page layout. This division allows people to develop skill in a smaller set of tasks. However, they also need shared deadlines and an agreed format. Otherwise, individually polished pieces may arrive too late or fit together poorly when the team assembles the finished publication.
cloze_197.translation: 制作学生杂志不仅仅涉及撰写文章。每个编辑都专注于部分工作，但杂志仍然需要协调，以便将单独的贡献形成一个连贯的期刊。一个人可以检查事实，另一个人可以安排照片，第三个人可以检查页面布局。这种划分允许人们在较小的任务集中培养技能。然而，他们还需要共同的截止日期和商定的格式。否则，当团队组装成品出版物时，单独打磨的作品可能会太晚到达或组合不良。

cloze_198.source: A student group has already paid a nonrefundable fee to prepare a stage backdrop. The payment cannot be recovered, regardless of whether the group continues with its original plan or chooses another activity. Therefore, the next decision concerns the future benefits and remaining costs of each option. Continuing might still be worthwhile, but the lost fee alone does not make it so. The group compares the time, materials, and expected use of the finished backdrop with what an alternative would require. The earlier expense stays the same whichever future option they select.
cloze_198.translation: 一个学生团体已经支付了不可退还的费用来准备舞台背景。无论团体是否继续原计划或选择其他活动，均无法收回付款。因此，下一个决策涉及每个选项的未来收益和剩余成本。继续可能仍然值得，但仅损失费用并不足以证明这一点。该小组将完成的背景的时间、材料和预期用途与替代方案的要求进行比较。无论他们选择哪个未来选项，之前的费用都保持不变。

cloze_199.source: A rock can acquire a different structure without becoming liquid. Heat and pressure may change its minerals while the rock remains solid. This process is called metamorphism, which differs from melting and then cooling into a new rock. Mineral grains may grow or become arranged in a different pattern. The resulting texture can provide clues about conditions deep below the surface. However, a geologist examines several features together, since no single visible stripe reveals the complete history of every specimen. The important distinction is that these changes occur within solid material.
cloze_199.translation: 岩石可以在不变成液体的情况下获得不同的结构。热量和压力可能会改变其矿物质，而岩石仍保持固态。这个过程称为变质作用，它不同于熔化然后冷却成新的岩石。矿物颗粒可能会生长或以不同的方式排列。由此产生的纹理可以提供有关地表深处条件的线索。然而，地质学家会同时检查多个特征，因为没有一个可见的条纹可以揭示每个标本的完整历史。重要的区别是这些变化发生在固体材料内。

cloze_200.source: A simple sand dune can move even though it has no solid base that slides. Wind carries grains up its gentle slope and over the crest. They then fall down the steeper side when enough sand accumulates near the top. Repeated transfers gradually shift the dune in the direction of the prevailing wind. The individual grains travel, while the overall shape is continually rebuilt. Vegetation, moisture, and changes in wind direction can affect this movement. Thus, tracking a dune involves comparing the position of its outline over time, rather than searching for a single rigid object underneath it.
cloze_200.translation: 一个简单的沙丘即使没有可以滑动的坚实底座，也可以移动。风将沙粒吹上缓坡并越过沙丘顶部。当顶部附近积累了足够的沙子时，它们就会从陡峭的一侧掉下来。反复的转移逐渐使沙丘向盛行风的方向移动。单个颗粒在移动，而整体形状不断重建。植被、湿度和风向的变化都会影响这种运动。因此，跟踪沙丘需要比较其轮廓随时间的位置，而不是搜索其下方的单个刚性物体。

cloze_201.source: A bend in a river can gradually change its position. Water often flows faster around the outer bank, where it wears away soil, while slower water deposits sand along the inner bank. These two processes move material from one place to another. Over time, the curve can become more pronounced or shift across the valley floor. A drawing of only the current channel therefore captures one stage in an ongoing process. Comparing older channel outlines can reveal how the river has occupied different parts of the surrounding land.
cloze_201.translation: 河流的拐弯处会逐渐改变其位置。水流通常在外岸流动得更快，从而磨损土壤，而较慢的水流则沿着内岸沉积沙子。这两个过程将材料从一个地方移动到另一个地方。随着时间的推移，曲线可能会变得更加明显或跨越谷底。因此，仅绘制当前通道即可捕获正在进行的过程中的一个阶段。比较旧河道轮廓可以揭示河流如何占据周围土地的不同部分。

cloze_202.source: Groundwater is not always stored in a large underground river. Much of it occupies tiny spaces between grains or within cracks, and can move where those openings are connected to one another. A layer may contain many pores yet transmit water poorly if the pores do not connect. This distinction helps explain why some materials hold water without allowing it to flow through easily. In a saturated zone, available openings are filled with water. Wells draw on this stored resource, and its movement depends on both the connections and differences in water pressure.
cloze_202.translation: 地下水并不总是储存在大型地下河中。其中大部分占据了颗粒之间或裂缝内的微小空间，并且可以在这些开口相互连接的地方移动。一层可能包含许多孔隙，但如果孔隙不连通，则透水性很差。这种区别有助于解释为什么有些材料可以容纳水而不允许其轻易流过。在饱和区域，可用的开口充满了水。井利用这种储存的资源，其运动取决于孔隙之间的连通情况及水压差异。

cloze_203.source: Some cave formations grow as dripping water leaves dissolved minerals behind. When water loses carbon dioxide, it may deposit calcite on the ceiling, forming an iciclelike shape that hangs above the floor. A drop that falls farther may leave another small deposit below. Over many such events, an upward growth can develop on the floor. These formations need suitable water chemistry and do not appear under every drip. The material builds up gradually as mineral matter leaves the water; the process does not require the water to freeze into ice.
cloze_203.translation: 有些洞穴沉积体是在滴水留下原先溶解的矿物质时逐渐长成的。当水失去二氧化碳时，它可能会在天花板上沉积方解石，形成悬挂在地板上方的冰柱状形状。落到下方的水滴可能又在那里留下少量沉积物。这样反复多次后，洞穴地面上就可能长出向上的沉积体。这些沉积体的形成需要适当的水化学性质，并且不会在每次滴水下出现。当矿物质离开水中时，这些物质逐渐积累；该过程不需要将水冻结成冰。

cloze_204.source: The two sides of a fault do not necessarily slide past each other smoothly. Friction can keep them locked while nearby rock continues to deform, so stored energy builds up until the fault slips. Some of that energy then travels outward as seismic waves. The shaking is a response to the sudden release, not evidence that an empty hole has opened beneath the ground. Different parts of a fault may behave differently. This account explains a common earthquake mechanism without providing an exact schedule for when the next slip will occur.
cloze_204.translation: 断层的两侧不一定能顺利地滑过。当附近的岩石继续变形时，摩擦力可以使它们保持锁定状态，因此储存的能量会不断积累，直到断层滑动。然后，其中一些能量以地震波的形式向外传播。震动是对突然释放的反应，而不是地面下出现空洞的证据。断层的不同部分可能表现不同。该描述解释了一种常见的地震机制，但没有提供下一次地震发生时间的确切时间表。

cloze_205.source: An archaeologist finds a dated coin beneath an undisturbed floor. The floor must have been laid after the coin was made, but it could have been completed many years later. The coin might have circulated for decades before being lost. Its date therefore sets an earliest possible time for the floor, provided the deposit really remained sealed. Other objects or building records may narrow the interval further. This reasoning depends on the order of events: manufacture came before loss, and the final floor covering came after the coin reached that position.
cloze_205.translation: 一位考古学家在未受扰动的地板下发现了一枚可以确定年代的硬币。地板一定是在这枚硬币铸造之后铺设的，但也可能晚了许多年才完工。这枚硬币可能流通了几十年后才遗失。因此，只要埋藏层确实一直保持封闭，硬币的年代就能确定地板最早可能铺设的时间。其他物品或建筑记录可能进一步缩小这个时间范围。这种推理依赖事件的先后顺序：硬币先被制造，后被遗失；而地板最后的覆盖层是在硬币到达那个位置之后才铺上的。

cloze_206.source: A stone in a courtyard wall carries lettering that faces inward. Builders reused the stone from an earlier structure, turning its carved surface toward the inside so that only its plain back was visible. During repairs, the hidden inscription becomes accessible again. The words describe the stone's previous setting, while the mortar around it belongs to the later wall. Recording both contexts allows a researcher to follow the object's changing role. A photograph of the letters alone would omit the evidence that the same piece had served in two different buildings.
cloze_206.translation: 庭院墙上的一块石头上刻着朝内的文字。建造者重复使用了早期建筑中的石头，将其雕刻表面转向内部，这样就只能看到其平坦的背面。在修复过程中，隐藏的铭文可以再次访问。这些文字描述了石头原先所在的环境，而它周围的灰浆则属于后来的墙。记录这两种情况可以让研究人员跟踪对象不断变化的角色。只拍刻字的照片，会遗漏这块石头曾用于两座不同建筑的证据。

cloze_207.source: A town's name appears with two spellings in an archive. The catalogue links both forms to one entry, allowing readers to find related records even if they search under either spelling. The cross reference preserves the wording found in older documents without creating two separate towns. A researcher can follow the link and then compare dates, locations, and descriptions within the records. The shared entry organizes access; each document still retains its original text. This arrangement supports discovery while keeping later editorial choices distinct from what the historical writers actually wrote.
cloze_207.translation: 城镇名称在档案中以两种拼写形式出现。该目录将两种形式链接到一个条目，使读者即使在任一拼写下搜索也能找到相关记录。交叉引用保留了旧文档中的措辞，而不创建两个单独的城镇。研究人员可以点击链接，然后比较记录中的日期、位置和描述。共享条目组织访问；每份文件仍保留其原始文本。这种安排支持发现，同时保持后来的编辑选择与历史作家实际撰写的内容不同。

cloze_208.source: Two shipping lists count the same kind of grain in different ways. One lists sacks, whereas another records weight, so their totals cannot be compared until the size of each sack is known. A note states that every sack in the first shipment held twenty kilograms. Ten such sacks therefore represented two hundred kilograms of grain. The second list already gives its total in kilograms.
